column1: # System text lines that are spoken (jpreader tts sysNN), and who says them. Story lines have their
# speakers in the text dump; system lines don't. lines: ranges like 1-13,17. gender and age pick a crowd
# voice when the speaker has no CAST voice (tts.py); Rotom has none on purpose, so it never falls back to a
# human voice. scene (optional) goes into clips.csv. Lines left out (menus, answers, choices, labels, lines
# built from item or number variables, empty {BDFF} slots) are never voiced. Lines with the same voice and
# cleaned text share one take (Rotom's affection variants).
# Only text shown in the field's talk window reaches the voice player (docs: voice spec; battle and app
# windows only feed the peek): 20 and 17 are battle text and 57 is Mantine Surf's lesson panel, so their
# rows are commented out (remove the "# " to price or voice them once the player takes those windows).
# 89 and 126 are loaded by FieldMenu (the lower-screen Rotom) and the Pokédex app, not by the field scripts:
# most of their lines are lower-screen text that won't play either. Seeded from the system-speaker research

column1: # --- 89: Rotom field chatter, story hints, affection talk, Roto Loto. Up to 4 affection variants per hint,
# mostly identical in Japanese. Excluded: 83 player-choice lines and the empty slots.
# --- 126: Rotom's Pokédex-progress and evaluation lines; 180-389 are 3 affection variants of the base texts.
# --- 76: Poké Finder, Rotom's lines only (16-36 are UI; the online photo comments are left out).
# --- 77: Poké Finder controls: Rotom's prompts, upgrade notices, reactions while shooting.
# --- 17: battle text; only Rotom's own battle lines. Battle text.
# --- 57: Mantine Surf lessons, as the instructor (the Swimmer on the beach who repeats them). Lesson panel text.
# --- 95: shop staff, only lines without item, price or number variables. Some genders are unverified guesses.
# --- trainers (generated) ---
# Which trainer says each line, from the game's own lookup trainer::TrainerMessage::GetStringID (code.bin
# 0x4307C4): a/1/1/8 has one 4-byte entry per trainer ID (u8 count, u8 0, u16 first entry in a/1/1/9), and
# a/1/1/9 one per message (u8 kind, u8 0, u16 line of system text 109). Trainer IDs above 652 are refused
# (their entries are dead data). Trainer -> class: a/1/0/6 byte 0; class -> gender: a/1/0/5 byte 0; names
# are system 110 and 111. Speaker: the named character, else the English class name; age bands from
# people.CLASS_AGES or a class guess. Built by the trainer-text research pass (2026-10-18).
# --- 109, kinds 0 (before a battle) and 2 (after it): shown in the field talk window, so they play. Kind 1
# (defeated, in battle) and 8 (too few Pokémon for a double battle) are left out. 526 lines.
